summary: The statement and proof are correct. Theorem 5.2 and Lemma 5.3 were checked in the cited arXiv v3 source and provide exactly the hollow-polytope classification invoked. The width argument, the explicit exclusions of its tetrahedral representatives, and the boundary-cone subdivision argument establish the claimed interior point and normalized-volume lower bound D >= 34. The index-two lattice construction and coset interchange preserve the required integer counts and source reflection bound; the three four-point polygon cases are exhaustive, and both surviving triangular cases give the stated exact prism normal forms. The paired-height interval argument is valid for all integer parameters, including nearest-integer ties, odd heights, and the even-height singleton, yielding at least floor(D/2) + 4 >= 21 points in the actual prism. Exact integer-inequality checks over h = 1 through 40 and alpha, beta = -3 through 3 for both normal forms found no counterexample. Since K is contained in the prism and has exactly twenty integer points, the asserted point outside K follows.
